description: This PHP file contains a unit test class 'ModulesAPITest' for testing the 'ModulesAPI' class within the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management System. It defines multiple test methods to verify the API's behavior, including getting all modules, updating modules, and handling not implemented methods such as create, getOne, and delete. The test class uses mock objects and data providers to run parameterized tests, ensuring the API functions correctly within the project.

classes.name: ModulesAPITest
